binding: THY-PLACE-CASTLE-001 is NOT a second castle. The castle already exists in live canon as ER-CASTLE-ROYAL-001. This record is subordinate to it and carries only the Time Run era-binding question. Any Time Run surface must reference ER-CASTLE-ROYAL-001.

naming_correction.finding: The live backend names this place "ROYAL CASTLE — CANONICAL NAME OPEN (DO NOT GUESS)" with truth_state OPEN_PENDING_CHAIRMAN_NAME_RECOVERY.
naming_correction.consequence: The task is name RECOVERY, not name selection. The Chairman already has a name for this castle; it is to be recovered, not proposed.
naming_correction.gate: THY-NAME-PROVENANCE-001 (LOCKED) prohibits silently replacing canon names with assistant-invented fantasy names, and requires every name to carry a source class.
naming_correction.precedent: At sequence 660 the Chairman answered "no" to a proposed derived name (Sayreth House) and it was withdrawn; names stay OPEN_WORD until he gives them.
naming_correction.action: All three candidate names proposed in WR-TIMERUN-581 are WITHDRAWN. They are retained below with their derivations and the reason for withdrawal. None was ever canon.
naming_correction.language_finding: No EdereAirah native-language, lexicon or morpheme registry exists in the live backend. Searched all 919 public tables for language/lexicon/morpheme/tongue columns on 2026-10-05: the only match is er_vehicle_brand_language_registry (vehicle brands). The morphemes used in the withdrawn candidates therefore had no canonical source and could not have had one.

withdrawn_name_candidates.name: Ederehald

derivation.language: Native tongue of EdereAirah (CANDIDATE — the language itself is unnamed in the backend)
derivation.history: The structure remained while its occupants, its trades and its families changed. It is named for what it did, not for who held it.

morphemes.gloss: that which remains, that which endures — the root the land name itself carries
a holding, a keep, a thing kept

withdrawn_name_candidates.strength: Ties the castle directly to the land name and to the one fact true in every era: it is still standing.
withdrawn_name_candidates.weakness: Says nothing about the site itself. Any enduring building in EdereAirah could carry it.
withdrawn_name_candidates.withdrawn_reason: Live canon marks this place DO NOT GUESS and the state is name RECOVERY. The derivation rested on an EdereAirah language that does not exist in any backend registry.
withdrawn_name_candidates.retained_as: record of what was proposed and why it was withdrawn

withdrawn_name_candidates.name: Ariahdura

derivation.history: The site has always been the point at which people enter the land and leave it — gate, customs house, receiving hall, and under Time Run, threshold between living eras.

morphemes.gloss: given ground, the land, that which was granted
threshold, doorway, the place of crossing

withdrawn_name_candidates.strength: Earns its name from the site's function and pre-carries the Time Run threshold role without needing Time Run to justify it.
withdrawn_name_candidates.weakness: If ENTRY_EXIT does not resolve to threshold sites, the name points at a mechanic that was not chosen.
withdrawn_name_candidates.withdrawn_reason: Live canon marks this place DO NOT GUESS and the state is name RECOVERY. The derivation rested on an EdereAirah language that does not exist in any backend registry.
withdrawn_name_candidates.retained_as: record of what was proposed and why it was withdrawn

withdrawn_name_candidates.name: Torvaenah

derivation.history: Named for how it was first sighted from the water: high stone standing toward the approach, visible before anything else on the shore.

morphemes.gloss: facing the water, turned toward the approach

derivation.reading: The high stone that faces the water.

withdrawn_name_candidates.strength: Purely geographic. True in every era regardless of who holds the castle or which mechanics are selected.
withdrawn_name_candidates.weakness: Requires the water relation to be fixed as an invariant before the name can be sealed.
withdrawn_name_candidates.withdrawn_reason: Live canon marks this place DO NOT GUESS and the state is name RECOVERY. The derivation rested on an EdereAirah language that does not exist in any backend registry.

naming_law: NATIVE LAND + LANGUAGE + HISTORY still holds as the derivation law, but it cannot be exercised here: the language is UNKNOWN and the name is to be recovered, not derived.
prohibition_reason: Chairman directive. The castle is named from the land, not from a family.
